hero.heading:
Simulate reality,
mirror the future.
hero.subheading: SimulMirror extracts seeds from the real world to build high-fidelity parallel digital worlds, where thousands of agents with distinct personas and long-term memory evolve on their own.

capabilities.title: A Five-Stage Prediction Engine
capabilities.subtitle: From a single real-world seed to an interactive digital world

graph.title: Knowledge Graph
graph.desc: Automatically extract entities and relations from documents and build a high-fidelity graph in Zep Cloud.

env.title: Environment Setup
env.desc: Generate agent personas with personality, memory and behavioral logic for every entity.

simulation.title: Crowd Simulation
simulation.desc: Parallel simulation across Twitter and Reddit, where thousands of agents interact and evolve.

report.title: Report Generation
report.desc: A ReACT report agent retrieves and reflects autonomously to produce a detailed prediction report.

interaction.title: Deep Interaction
interaction.desc: Inject variables from a god's-eye view and chat with the report or any agent to steer the future.

workflow.title: Predict the Future in Five Steps

step1.title: Upload a Seed
step1.desc: Upload news, policy drafts, financial signals or stories, then describe what you want to predict.

step2.title: Auto-Build the World
step2.desc: The system generates the ontology, graph and agents automatically — no manual settings required.

step3.title: Run the Simulation
step3.desc: Run crowd-intelligence simulations in an isolated process and monitor social evolution in real time.

step4.title: Get the Report
step4.desc: Receive an interactive digital world and a detailed Markdown prediction report.

step5.title: Deep Interaction
step5.desc: Inject variables from a god's-eye view and chat with the report or any agent to precisely deduce future trajectories.

process.ontologyDesc: The LLM analyzes the document and prediction goal to extract a real-world seed and auto-generate a fitting ontology.
process.graphragDesc: Based on the ontology, the document is chunked and sent to Zep to build the knowledge graph, extracting entities/relations and forming temporal memory and community summaries.
process.envDesc: Generate agent personas with personality, memory and behavior for each entity, and auto-generate the simulation config.
process.chatAgent: Chat with any agent in the world
process.survey: Send a survey to the world
process.reportAgentDesc: A fast conversational version of the report agent that can call 4 tools with SimulMirror's full memory.
process.emptyChat: Chat with the Report Agent to dive into the report
process.toolInsightDesc: Aligns real-world seed data with the simulation state, combining Global/Local Memory for deep cross-time attribution analysis.
process.toolPanoramaDesc: A graph breadth-traversal algorithm that reconstructs propagation paths and captures the full information-flow topology.
process.toolQuickDesc: A GraphRAG instant query interface optimized for indexing, used to quickly extract node attributes and discrete facts.
process.toolInterviewDesc: Autonomous interviews that run in parallel with individuals in the simulated world, collecting unstructured opinions and psychological states.
process.noAgents: No individuals to chat with yet (prepare the environment or run a simulation first)

process.agentChatHint: Ask something to start chatting with this individual

process.maxRoundsHint: More rounds means richer evolution but higher LLM cost (start with fewer).

process.injectHint: As a god, inject a new event or variable; it takes effect from the next round.
